description.value: A well-equipped municipal campground on the Elk River with showers, a cookhouse, and wildlife-resistant lockers for tenters; spectacular mountain views and walking distance to full town services make it an ideal resupply stop deep in the Kootenay Rockies.

address.value: 350 Elk Valley Hwy, Elkford, BC V0B 1H0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a 78-site municipal campground with showers, flush toilets, cookhouse shelter, wildlife-resistant storage lockers, electrical hookups, fire pits, and picnic tables. It explicitly states the campground is within walking distance of groceries, gas stations, and restaurants. Online booking is available. OSM tags confirm the website URL and fee=yes. No phone or address is available from either source. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, laundry, cyclist discounts, or bike tools.
concerns: OSM tags this as caravan_site but the website confirms it also serves tenters with dedicated storage lockers
No phone number or street address available from OSM or website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-equipped municipal campground within walking distance of town services in the Elk Valley, with showers, cookhouse shelter, and bear-safe food storage—an excellent fit for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: showers, cookhouse shelter, wildlife-resistant storage lockers... within walking distance of groceries, gas stations, and restaurants
